mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalProducts, SUM(CASE WHEN product_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activeProducts, SUM(CASE WHEN product_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactiveProducts, SUM(sold_count) as totalSales, SUM(price * sold_count) as totalRevenue, AVG(price) as averagePrice FROM tour_product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT product_type as productType, CASE WHEN product_type = 1 THEN '旅行路线' WHEN product_type = 2 THEN '酒店客房' WHEN product_type = 3 THEN '景区门票' ELSE '其他' END as typeName, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(sold_count) as sales, SUM(price * sold_count) as revenue FROM tour_product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT product_id as productId, product_name as productName, sold_count as salesCount, price * sold_count as revenue FROM tour_product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND sold_count > 0 ORDER BY sold_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as sales, SUM(price * sold_count) as revenue FROM tour_product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_statistics ( merchant_id, stat_date, total_products, active_products, inactive_products, total_sales, total_revenue, average_price ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{statDate}, #{totalProducts}, #{activeProducts}, #{inactiveProducts}, #{totalSales}, #{totalRevenue}, #{averagePrice} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_products = VALUES(total_products), active_products = VALUES(active_products), inactive_products = VALUES(inactive_products), total_sales = VALUES(total_sales), total_revenue = VALUES(total_revenue), average_price = VALUES(average_price), update_time = NOW()
